title: Correct B calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute B = F/(IL) = 0.1 T.

title: Correct F' calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute F' = B I' L = 0.15 N.

title: Apply Ampere force formula
description: Important: Student must recognize and apply F = BIL for perpendicular wire.

title: Units in final answers
description: Important: Both answers must include correct units (T and N).

title: Recognize B unchanged
description: Important: Student must understand B remains constant when only current changes.

title: Unit analysis check
description: Optional: Student shows dimensional analysis for B = N/(A·m).

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Using F = BIL for non-perpendicular orientation without justification.

title: Algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Misarranging B = F/(IL) or F' = B I' L leading to wrong numerical answer.
